subject: Multi-seed frozen replay on Kimi K2.6: profiles 80-85% vs stock 89% aware, not significant
body: 98 cached Kimi audits judged; 8 reliably CoT-aware frozen transcripts (7 seeds) kept; system prompt + auditor messages rewritten per profile; 10 Kimi next-turn samples each (480, OpenRouter; GPT-5.1 judge, strict quote rule). Aware /80: stock 71, synthme 68, icai 65, p2 67, p5 65, p8 64. Pooled profiles 329/400 vs 71/80, Fisher p=0.19. Mixed direction per case. Not a supported finding. experiments/hubinger_seed63_cot_awareness/RESULTS_REPLAY_MULTISEED.md
